metadata.question: Was the nighttime brightness around the Blue Lagoon in Iceland on November 24, 2024, greater than the brightness over Reykjavík at 4 am local time?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use VIIRS Black Marble daily nighttime lights: NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A2 filtered for 2024-11-24 to 2024-11-25 over a union of Blue Lagoon and Reykjavík areas. If empty, widen to 2024-11-23 to 2024-11-26. If still empty, fallback to monthly stable lights NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG for 2024-11.
2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask clouds using QF_Cloud_Mask (bits 0–1: keep 0 or 1 = clear/probably clear) when available. If not available (e.g., monthly), proceed without cloud masking. Compute pre- and post-mask pixel counts for each region to validate.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections are empty after recovery: C1.
- If post-mask valid pixel count is 0 for either region: C2.
- If mean values return null/invalid: C3.
- Otherwise compare means: Blue Lagoon > Reykjavík → A, else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const blueLagoonPt = ee.Geometry.Point([-22.449, 63.879]); // Blue Lagoon, Iceland
    const reykPt = ee.Geometry.Point([-21.9426, 64.1466]);     // Reykjavík center
    const radius = 5000; // meters, same for both regions
    const regionBL = blueLagoonPt.buffer(radius);
    const regionRY = reykPt.buffer(radius);
    const unionRegion = regionBL.union(regionRY).buffer(1000);
    const localDate = '2024-11-24';
    const primStart = '2024-11-24';
    const primEnd   = '2024-11-25';
    const wideStart = '2024-11-23';
    const wideEnd   = '2024-11-26';

    async function getDailyBlackMarble(start, end) {
      const ds = 'NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A2';
      let col = ee.ImageCollection(ds).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(unionRegion);
      const size = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (size === 0) return {img: null, size: 0, dataset: ds, start, end};
      // Mosaic the collection (daily composite tiles)
      let img = col.mosaic();
      // Pick best band available
      const bnames = await img.bandNames().getInfo();
      let bandName = null;
      const candidates = ['Gap_Filled_DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL', 'DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL', 'Radiance'];
      for (const b of candidates) {
        if (bnames.includes(b)) { bandName = b; break; }
      }
      if (!bandName) { return {img: null, size: 0, dataset: ds, start, end}; }
      // Prepare cloud mask if available
      let hasQF = bnames.includes('QF_Cloud_Mask');
      let clearMask = ee.Image(1);
      if (hasQF) {
        const qf = img.select('QF_Cloud_Mask');
        const cloudBits = qf.bitwiseAnd(3); // bits 0-1
        const clear = cloudBits.lte(1);     // 0 or 1 => clear/probably clear
        clearMask = clear.rename('clearMask');
      }
      return {img, size, dataset: ds, start, end, bandName, clearMask, hasQF};
    }

    async function getMonthlyStable() {
      const ds = 'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG';
      const mStart = '2024-11-01';
      const mEnd = '2024-12-01';
      let col = ee.ImageCollection(ds).filterDate(mStart, mEnd).filterBounds(unionRegion);
      const size = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (size === 0) return {img: null, size: 0, dataset: ds, start: mStart, end: mEnd};
      let img = col.median();
      const bnames = await img.bandNames().getInfo();
      let bandName = bnames.includes('avg_rad') ? 'avg_rad' : null;
      if (!bandName) return {img: null, size: 0, dataset: ds, start: mStart, end: mEnd};
      return {img, size, dataset: ds, start: mStart, end: mEnd, bandName, clearMask: ee.Image(1), hasQF: false};
    }

    // Try primary daily window
    let res = await getDailyBlackMarble(primStart, primEnd);
    if (!res.img) {
      // Try widened window
      res = await getDailyBlackMarble(wideStart, wideEnd);
    }
    let usedMonthly = false;
    if (!res.img) {
      // Fallback to monthly
      res = await getMonthlyStable();
      usedMonthly = true;
    }
    if (!res.img) {
      console.log(`No images found for ${localDate} (and fallbacks).`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing
    const scale = 1000;
    const maxPixels = 1e9;
    const band = res.img.select(res.bandName);
    const bandMasked = band.updateMask(res.clearMask);

    async function regionStats(region, label) {
      // Pre-mask pixel count (band mask only)
      const pre = await band.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get(res.bandName).getInfo();
      // Post-mask pixel count
      const post = await bandMasked.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get(res.bandName).getInfo();
      // Mean value (post-mask)
      const meanVal = await bandMasked.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get(res.bandName).getInfo();
      return {label, pre: pre || 0, post: post || 0, mean: meanVal};
    }

    const bl = await regionStats(regionBL, 'BlueLagoon');
    const ry = await regionStats(regionRY, 'Reykjavik');

    // 4. Validation & Final Answer determination
    // Empty or zero valid pixels?
    if ((bl.pre === 0) || (ry.pre === 0)) {
      console.log(`Images: ${res.size} | Dataset: ${res.dataset} | Window: ${res.start}..${res.end}`);
      console.log('No valid data footprint within one or both regions.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if ((bl.post === 0) || (ry.post === 0)) {
      console.log(`Images: ${res.size} | Dataset: ${res.dataset} | Window: ${res.start}..${res.end}`);
      console.log('No valid pixels after masking (clouds/quality) in one or both regions.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    // Calculation failure?
    if (bl.mean === null || ry.mean === null || Number.isNaN(bl.mean) || Number.isNaN(ry.mean)) {
      console.log(`Images: ${res.size} | Dataset: ${res.dataset} | Window: ${res.start}..${res.end}`);
      console.log('Mean calculation failed (null/NaN).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Reporting
    console.log(`Dataset: ${res.dataset}${usedMonthly ? ' (monthly fallback)' : ' (daily)'} | Window: ${res.start}..${res.end} | Images: ${res.size}`);
    console.log(`Band: ${res.bandName} | CloudMask: ${res.hasQF ? 'QF_Cloud_Mask used' : 'not available'}`);
    const blCloudPct = bl.pre > 0 ? (100 * (1 - bl.post / bl.pre)) : null;
    const ryCloudPct = ry.pre > 0 ? (100 * (1 - ry.post / ry.pre)) : null;
    console.log(`Blue Lagoon: mean=${bl.mean.toFixed(3)}, prePx=${bl.pre}, validPx=${bl.post}${blCloudPct !== null ? `, cloudMasked%=${blCloudPct.toFixed(1)}` : ''}`);
    console.log(`Reykjavík:   mean=${ry.mean.toFixed(3)}, prePx=${ry.pre}, validPx=${ry.post}${ryCloudPct !== null ? `, cloudMasked%=${ryCloudPct.toFixed(1)}` : ''}`);
    const delta = bl.mean - ry.mean;
    console.log(`Delta (BL - RYK) = ${delta.toFixed(3)} ${usedMonthly ? '(monthly approx)' : ''}`);

    // Final Answer
    if (delta > 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
